text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan gave it her all, but... she 
was defeated by Mejiro McQueen, who had 
dedicated her entire life to conquering 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Mejiro McQueen showed respect to Mejiro 
Ryan for her brave effort, and promised 
their next showdown would be at Ryan's 
specialty distance.

Her next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen, 
which will decide the king of spring 
middle-distance. Will Mejiro Ryan manage 
to break into the top ranks of the fan 
vote?
